# LLM.txt Mastery

> LLM.txt Mastery is a SaaS platform for validating, generating, and deploying llms.txt files. It helps website owners make their content discoverable by AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity through quality-scored, spec-compliant llms.txt files with deployment guidance.

Last updated: 2026-07-25

## What This Tool Does

LLM.txt Mastery provides three core capabilities:

1. **Validator** — Checks existing llms.txt files against the official llmstxt.org specification. Scores quality (0-100), detects robots.txt conflicts, validates URL accessibility, identifies framework type (React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, etc.), and checks all 4 standard file locations.

2. **Generator** — Crawls your website, discovers pages via sitemap/robots.txt/crawling, scores each page for AI citation potential (1-10), and generates a structured llms.txt file with only your highest-value content. Supports JavaScript rendering for SPAs.

3. **Deployment Guidance** — Provides the complete deployment package: file download, HTML discovery tag, robots.txt directive, platform-specific instructions, and automated verification that AI crawlers can find your file.

## Pricing

- **Free Trial**: 7 days, 35 analyses, 500 pages each, all features, credit card required
- **Solo**: $4.95/mo — 20 analyses/month, 200 pages each, quality scoring
- **Growth**: $9.95/mo — 35 analyses/month, 500 pages each, priority processing, CSV/JSON export
- **Scale**: $19.95/mo — 100 analyses/month, 1,000 pages each, JavaScript rendering, API access

## Technical Details

- **Validation**: Checks spec compliance, URL accessibility, robots.txt conflicts, content quality, freshness, and token count
- **Generation**: AI-enhanced page descriptions, quality scoring (1-10), category tagging, content clustering
- **Formats**: Standard llms.txt, extended llms-full.txt, minimal llms-mini.txt
- **Framework Support**: React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Next.js, Nuxt, Gatsby, Astro, WordPress (17+ platforms)
- **API**: RESTful API v1 with key authentication, rate limiting, and tier-based access
